notes.title: The fart girl listened to the feedback of the users.
notes.content:
Update Contents
1. When some content is moved to the standby screen after play, an error has been found that does not proceed normally when playing again. We've solved this problem.

2. In Dragon Taming, I found an error that does not reset the time seconds when I press the G key. We've solved this problem.

3. Some users have been found to be lagging in the part where the sea comes out. We solved this by slightly lowering the quality of the sea and solving some errors.

4. Some users said that the fart girl's appearance after her death was scary, so we modified it so that there was no body left. This also improves performance.

5. I removed the camera that showed my face when I farted. By eliminating this camera, I got a great help in optimization. However, it was not removed from this stage because I thought it was necessary in the dragon taming.

6. There is a severe lag on the Dreamy Forest stage, and I have solved some of it. However, it has not decreased significantly as it is a problem caused by a lot of trees. We will consider logging in the future.

7. After deleting the full video on the store page, I plan to upload the edited video. Watch the full video on YouTube.

notes.title: The fart girl has changed!
notes.content:
The update has been changed at the request of many people!

1. I made it easier to improve part 1, which was too difficult even though it was in the tutorial stage.

2. If you press Alt + Enter, the window mode is possible.

3. Stage 6 rhythm game has been added.

4. It has been changed so that all stages are accessible without breaking the stages step by step.


Since launching the game, 15 people have purchased it, and 5 of them have refunded it. I realized that as a developer, I still lack a lot. If you don't like my game, you can refund it.

However, please do an updated version. Fart girl has changed a lot now. It's so heartbreaking to see the game that I worked hard on collapse like this. Please show us the other stages.


++ I was in a hurry to update today and couldn't review it carefully, so some errors were found in stage 6. It's not a fatal error, but there was a problem that playback did not work if I went to the standby screen after the song came out and then came back in. Fixed it.

++ It was so stressful to have to open the book from the beginning when I went to the standby screen. So, when you go back to the standby screen, you return to the previous page.

++ Fixed some image errors on idle screen.
